rowJSON.title: Curves
rowJSON.description: Group: smooth curves with parameters (peak position, spread, steepness).

rowJSON.title: Custom
rowJSON.description: Group: the user types the value of every period.

rowJSON.title: Front-loaded (start)
rowJSON.description: Spends the budget early: the first days get the biggest share, the last day almost nothing.
rowJSON.shape: Heaviest at the start, falling to zero at the end.

rowJSON.title: Back-loaded (end)
rowJSON.description: Spends the budget late: the first days get almost nothing, the last days the biggest share.
rowJSON.shape: Zero at the start, heaviest at the end.

rowJSON.title: Uniform (even)
rowJSON.shape: An equal share in every period.

rowJSON.title: Normal (Gaussian)
rowJSON.description: Few at the start and the end, most around the peak. Peak position and spread are a share of the timeline (0..1).
rowJSON.shape: A symmetric bell; the peak is in the middle of the timeline by default.

rowJSON.title: Logarithmic, front
rowJSON.description: Most of the budget in the first days, then less and less. Steepness: the bigger, the faster the start.
rowJSON.shape: A fast start that flattens, with a long thin tail.

rowJSON.title: Logarithmic, back
rowJSON.description: Little at the start, most of the budget in the last days. Steepness: the bigger, the sharper the rise.
rowJSON.shape: The mirror of Logarithmic, front: a thin early share and a sharp rise toward the end.

rowJSON.title: Epidemic (wave)
rowJSON.description: A wave: slow start, steep rise to the peak, long decline. Peak position and spread are a share of the timeline (0..1).
rowJSON.shape: A slow start, a steep rise to a peak and a long decline (right-skewed).

rowJSON.title: Manual
rowJSON.description: The only editable one: the share of every period is typed by the user.
rowJSON.shape: The user enters the value for each period.
